hypothesis: The shared-tree dense multitask model produced a small stable 2020 direction but could not learn task-specific smooth representations. A TabM shared representation with proper Bernoulli heads can use dense failure-counter and pitch-group supervision while retaining a separately weighted control-success head.

relationship_to_prior_work.catboost_dense_multitask: Used eight MultiRMSE regression outputs sharing tree splits and reached only +21.37 R points at its best 2020 blend.
relationship_to_prior_work.tabm_outcome: Used one mutually exclusive outcome softmax and never shared pitch-group and failure-bit supervision as simultaneous Bernoulli tasks.
relationship_to_prior_work.new_structure: One TabM representation, eight sigmoid heads, explicit per-head weights, and no Cartesian rare classes or deployable pitch selector.

source_protocol.route: candidate blend on R only; exact C on F
source_protocol.ranking: maximize R gain, then full gain, then smaller gamma
source_protocol.on_2020_fail: Close without training or reading 2021+ candidate metrics.

candidate.loss: weighted sum of independent BCE plus Brier for every head

data_contract.auxiliary_labels: completed-history next same-pitcher official counter increments and pitchmix increments
